annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Commission, Directorate-General for Communications Networks, Content and Technology (G7 Hiroshima AI Process)
key_provisions_or_claims: Non-exhaustive, living list of guiding principles for organizations developing advanced AI systems
Builds on the OECD AI Principles
Applies to all AI actors across design, development, deployment and use
Targets foundation models and generative AI
Accompanied by a voluntary Code of Conduct for AI developers
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page announcing the G7 Hiroshima Process International Guiding Principles for Organizations Developing Advanced AI Systems (30 Oct 2023). Voluntary, living principles building on the OECD AI Principles, covering foundation models and generative AI, to promote safe, secure and trustworthy AI. The page links to the full text and the Code of Conduct.
